title: Mouse reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='22' y='58' width='56' height='30' rx='3' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <rect x='26' y='62' width='48' height='22' rx='2' fill='#f4f1de'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='84' stroke='#c8b6a6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='68' x2='46' y2='68' stroke='#b8a99a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <line x1='30' y1='78' x2='44' y2='78' stroke='#b8a99a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='68' x2='70' y2='68' stroke='#b8a99a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='73' x2='70' y2='73' stroke='#b8a99a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='78' x2='68' y2='78' stroke='#b8a99a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <circle cx='66' cy='17' r='6' fill='#f0a6b5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='28' r='3.2' fill='#2b2d42'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='28' r='3.2' fill='#2b2d42'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='27' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='27' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='2.8' fill='#f0a6b5'/>

  <line x1='50' y1='36' x2='60' y2='39' stroke='#c3ccd6' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='36' cy='60' r='5' fill='#c3ccd6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='60' r='5' fill='#c3ccd6'/>

  <path d='M28 50 Q18 52 20 62' stroke='#f0a6b5' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
